season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/soda-butte-campground ('Open from July 1 - September 7th (weather dependent)'; Seasons of Use '7/1 -9/7 Weather Dependent.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Single site $20 per night; $5 per night each additional vehicle.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/soda-butte-campground ('Single Site: $20 per night', 'Additional Vehicle: $5 per night'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: First-come, first-served; no reservations on Recreation.gov. May fill on summer weekends and holidays: arrive in the early afternoon.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/soda-butte-campground ('No Reservations: This campground does not use a reservation system, it is managed on a first-come, first-served basis. Be aware the campground may fill up on weekends & holidays during the summer months and you should arrive in the early afternoon'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Trailer/RV sites have an average parking spur of 22 x 60 ft; the access road is not suitable for vehicles longer than 48 ft. Hard-sided vehicles only, no tent camping.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/soda-butte-campground ('Camp sites: 27', 'Trailer/RV Sites Average Parking Spur: 22' x 60'', 'Access road not suitable for vehicles longer than 48'', 'THIS CAMPGROUND IS HARD SIDED VEHICLES ONLY - NO TENT CAMPING.'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/soda-butte-campground ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available at this site.'; trash pickup yes, food boxes), read 2026-10-22

note: Custer Gallatin NF (Gardiner RD) on the Beartooth Scenic Byway (US-212), ~1 mi E of Cooke City near Yellowstone's NE entrance, along Soda Butte Creek. Hard-sided vehicles only (grizzly country, no tents). --Claude
summary: Forest Service-run (Gardiner Ranger District), first-come first-served only. Confirmed FCFS/not reservable, 27 sites, vault toilets + potable water; season Jul 1 - Sep 7 (weather dependent) now dated; added $20/night (+$5 extra vehicle), 22x60-ft average spurs and the 48-ft access-road limit. Not stated: hookups/dump (derived 'none' left), pass discounts. No alert for this campground or US-212. Note trimmed.
